status: prospective transparent document-group adaptation; not published-score replication
design_basis: ten-fold CV from Mu thesis 4.3.1 and DiffusECI paper; document-level grouping supported by DiffusECI load; independent selection rotation adapted from existing project OOF protocol
membership_rule: sort by SHA256(UTF8(CTB-doccv-v1|filename)); assign index modulo 10; eval=i, selection=(i+1)%10, train=other folds
candidates: all annotated-mention unordered pairs within sentence; cross-sentence CLINK outside stated task
metric: positive binary micro P/R/F1; per-fold result and mean of outer folds; pooled result separately
